historical_reviews.deepseek: Cannot establish controller completeness or correctness without identity/topology manifest.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds path and property comparison and prohibits mutation.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Drive, volume and storage-summary rows do not replace controller-specific firmware/cache/path health.

original_test_intent: Verify every expected storage controller is present at the approved PCIe/slot path with correct identity, firmware, mode/cache properties and NVSM health OK.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load controller serial/device/BDF/slot/firmware/mode/cache/attached-path manifest; run exact `nvsm show controllers` read-only; retain raw identity/status/health/properties; compare completeness and controller-to-drive/volume relationships; correlate non-OK states without changing controller configuration.
manual_activity: Storage owner supplies the expected controller/topology manifest and dispositions every missing, mismatched or non-OK controller.
required_inputs: Firmware, mode, cache and attachment specification
safety_requirements: Never clear logs, reset or reconfigure controllers
Do not enable/disable cache or RAID mode

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The query is applicable but lacks controller identities, expected properties and attachment topology.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command and join every controller to the approved BDF/slot and storage-attachment manifest.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All controllers, all information and every health state remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a controller-keyed expected/observed table including location, firmware, mode/cache, attached paths and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes correctness and completeness deterministic while read-only.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Drive health cannot prove controller configuration or attachment completeness.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Virtual/logical controllers and multipath layers can duplicate views; physical identity must remain explicit.

project_override_considerations: Storage architecture owns expected controller mode, cache policy, firmware and attachment graph.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target controller inventory and health; missing reference data are project inputs and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Adds controller-to-path and controller-to-drive/volume relationships so a healthy label cannot hide a missing or misconfigured controller.
independent_technical_reasoning: Controller health is not reducible to attached drive health: firmware, cache policy, operating mode and upstream location can be wrong while media remain visible. A controller-specific manifest is therefore necessary.
